translation_snapshot.source: Equilibrium when firing a critical mind attack:
translation_snapshot.target: 精神暴击时回复失衡值：

translation_snapshot.source: Don't drink it, even if it tells you to.
translation_snapshot.target: 不要去喝它，即使它诱惑着你……

translation_snapshot.source: Whilst wearing leather or lighter armour, you gain %d%% Defense and %d%% Armour hardiness.
translation_snapshot.target: 当你身着轻甲和布甲时，你会增加 %d%% 近身闪避和 %d%% 护甲强度。

translation_snapshot.source: (Note that wearing mail or plate armour will interfere with stealth.)
translation_snapshot.target: （请注意，身穿重甲或板甲的时候不可以潜行。）

translation_snapshot.source: This voratun shield, coated with thick vines, was imbued with nature's power long ago by the Halfling General Almadar Riul, who used it to stave off the magic and diseases of orcish corruptors during the peak of the Pyre Wars.
translation_snapshot.target: 这块沃瑞钽盾牌表面被厚实的藤蔓所缠绕，其中注入了许多年前的半身人将军阿尔曼达·鲁伊尔的自然力量，他在烈火战争中用这个盾牌驱散了兽人堕落者的魔法与疾病。

translation_snapshot.source: The target's unnatural body has responded to damage taken.
translation_snapshot.target: 目标的诅咒之体对其所承受的苦难做出了回应。

translation_snapshot.source:
Overcharge your psionic focus with energy for %d turns, producing a different effect depending on what it is.
		A telekinetically wielded melee weapon enters a frenzy, striking up to %d enemies per turn, also increases the radius by %d.
		A mindstar will attempt to pull in all enemies within its normal range.
		A gem will fire an energy bolt at a random enemy in range 6, each turn for %0.1f damage. The type is determined by the colour of the gem. Damage scales with Mindpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
超载你的心灵聚焦 %d 轮，造成特殊效果。
		念动近战武器进入狂乱，每回合最多攻击 %d 个敌人，攻击半径同时增加 %d 格。
		灵晶会尝试将其正常范围内的所有敌人拉到身边。
		宝石每回合向 6 格内的一个随机敌人发射能量球，造成 %0.1f 伤害。伤害类型取决于宝石的颜色，伤害随精神强度提高。

translation_snapshot.source: Showing big healthbars and tactical borders.
You met a half-mad lumberjack fleeing a small village, rambling about an untold horror lurking there, slaughtering people.
translation_snapshot.target: 你遇到了一个从小村庄里逃出来的半疯癫的伐木工人，大声喊着有个没见过的吓人的东西在里面杀人。
